organic.title: Stellar: Larger Than Bitcoin?
organic.snippet: Stellar is an open network that allows money to move and store in the form of digital tokens.

organic.title: What is Stellar?
organic.snippet: Stellar is a decentralized, open-source, peer-to-peer network.

organic.title: Stellar Lumens
